tool.name: Convert a BED File to a BigWig
tool.description: Convert Ribosome Profile BED File to a BigWig

param.name: input2
param.label: Chromosome Sizes
param.help: Check out 'Get Chromosome Sizes' to fill this parameter

tool.help: Convert a four-column bedGraph ribosome profile to BigWig using matching chromosome sizes. Intervals are sorted by chromosome and start before conversion. Coordinates must be zero-based and half-open, and intervals must not overlap.
